WITH customer_stats AS (
    SELECT
        CustomerKey,
        count() AS order_count,
        avg(SalesAmount) AS avg_order_size
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    GROUP BY CustomerKey
),
thresholds AS (
    SELECT
        quantile(0.9)(order_count) AS p90_order_count,
        quantile(0.9)(avg_order_size) AS p90_avg_order_size
    FROM customer_stats
)
SELECT
    cs.CustomerKey,
    dc.FirstName,
    dc.LastName,
    cs.order_count,
    cs.avg_order_size
FROM customer_stats cs
CROSS JOIN thresholds t
JOIN retail.DimCustomer dc ON dc.CustomerKey = cs.CustomerKey
WHERE cs.order_count >= t.p90_order_count
  AND cs.avg_order_size >= t.p90_avg_order_size
ORDER BY cs.order_count DESC, cs.avg_order_size DESC
